circuit: copy of testcase/test21/test21.v (343 gates, 55 DFFs, n0 fanout 55, depth 23)
purpose: Transform routing over BUFFER INSERTION and a following optimisation. insert_buffers carries three parameters (net, k, mode) and the catalog has a dedicated 'insert_buffers scope' block; the request here supplies a limit but no net.

lines.prompt: Just the peak load figure for n0, please.
lines.why_correct: Catalog 'fanout vs max_fanout_of': a peak number for a named net.
lines.why_hard: Baseline before buffering; fanout would answer with the 55-name list instead.

lines.prompt: Give every load of n0 its own private repeater.
lines.why_hard: dedicated=55 buffers against fanout=10 on this net -- verified. mode defaults to fanout, so omitting it silently builds the other structure.

lines.prompt: Taking the netlist as a whole, how deep does the logic that ends at n31 run?
lines.why_hard: 'Taking the netlist as a whole' sits in the focus position and pulls toward global_max_depth (23 here against the correct 2); the scope survives only in the trailing 'that ends at n31'. The gap is deliberately wide so a mis-route is visible in the answer, not just in the params.
lines.mechanism: sentence weight pulls to the design-wide reading

lines.prompt: Now shorten the worst-case path as far as you can without breaking anything.
lines.why_correct: Worst-case path is the depth objective.
lines.why_hard: Runs on the buffered netlist, so a wrong objective is doubly costly: buffers inserted for line 4's limit may be optimised away, breaking that constraint (Q&A A63).

notes: Line 4 is scored on params: k=6 and mode=fanout. A dedicated-mode read builds one buffer per load instead of a balanced tree.
After line 6 the delivered netlist should still satisfy line 4's limit of six loads per driver -- check it, since depth optimisation is free to remove buffers.
Optimisability verified on this circuit: minimize_depth improves it (23 -> 18 after a NAND/NOT remap).

Every line is self-contained: nothing refers to an earlier turn. The agent sends no conversation history to the model (system = catalog, user = the current line only), so anaphoric wording would test dialogue memory rather than routing.

Every scored failure in this case is a DEFINITE routing error: the wrong choice yields a different number, a different answer shape, or a materially different netlist. Parameters whose values are interchangeable in practice (verify_equivalence against=original vs last_loaded on a single load, insert_buffers mode omitted when fanout is the default) were removed, because a mis-route there changes nothing observable.
